The code change in `scripts/supervise_faults.py` does what r218 says and nothing more. When a worker ends, a change under another side-by-side initiative's `.shop/work/<initiative>/` is no longer put back or named in the work-item's fault. Nothing under `features/` changed.

Instead the step now tolerates the timing, so whether i2's own run puts its file back (and faults p2) still depends on when sessions end. That case belongs to r215/r216, which w237 accepts.
- **The fix:** give the r218 scenario its own scoped clean-status step and restore the old assert, or list the change in the plan.

One Minor observation: a git rename line under another initiative's directory is still read as a single path. That was already true before these commits.
